rows.text:
Who can handle the wild, untamed power of the Astral Express!? Pom-Pom, now beyond control, has transformed into the Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom.
King Pom-Pom is a powerful mechatron obsessed with cleanliness and order. By its standards, this place is a mess and needs a thorough! Deep! Clean!
